why: variant A changed both frequency coverage and integration count at once, and the window guard showed the two cannot be separated from its result: A holds 21-52% of the Nyquist drift window, so candidates that vanish in A could have been lost to duration, to bandwidth, or to the drift range. B and C hold one axis at the survey's setting so each expansion is measured alone. Declaring them after seeing A is recorded here rather than hidden; neither variant's threshold, band or drift range was chosen from A's candidates.
